newsitem.title: USA: Empire of Carolina, EDT Toys, end deal.
newsitem.headline: Empire of Carolina, EDT Toys, end deal.

text.p: Empire of Carolina said Wednesday that privately-held EDT Toys LLC has said it does not intend to proceed with a previously-announced $50 million investment in the company.
The company gave no reason why the deal was terminated.
As a result, the company said it is evaluating other financial and strategic alternatives, including renewing discussions with other parties interested in purchasing assets from or investing in it.

The company also said it is also discussing the effect of the termination of the proposed transaction with its lenders. But Empire said no assurance can be given that it will obtain $6 million of financing by April 30, as required by the December 1996 amendment to its senior loan agreement, or that its lenders will agree to an extension of that deadline.
In the event that additional financing is not obtained, the company said there can be no assurance that its lenders will continue to finance operations beyond April 30.
